1 // Gandalf advisor — the SCORE / LABEL / SYNTHESIS seam (Wave 6 / serves NS4, NS6).
2 //
3 // This is the seam that turns vetted findings into honestly-scored, honestly-labelled,
4 // honestly-synthesised output. Three jobs, each pinned to a locked North-Star boundary and a
5 // deterministic gate (label/semantic TRUTH staying the advisory layer's job — PRINCIPLE-D):
6 //
7 //   • SCORE — DUAL-AXIS, NEVER COLLAPSED. Every suggestion is scored on TWO independent ordinal
8 //     axes: value-if-true (low→high) × groundedness (the evidence rung). The two are NEVER
9 //     collapsed into a single scalar — a high-value/low-grounded suggestion and a low-value/
10 //     high-grounded one are NOT interchangeable, and collapsing them would launder the one into
11 //     the other. `scoreDualAxis` returns the two axes side by side; `isDualAxisScore` /
12 //     COLLAPSED_SCORE_FIELDS detect a collapsed scalar.
13 //
14 //   • LABEL — TIERED, HONEST. Tier = the refutation outcome. ONLY the REFUTED drops; everything
15 //     else is kept and labelled (nothing unverified is asserted as real, but nothing un-refuted
16 //     is silently discarded either). The single-family ceiling is PROMISING, never GROUNDED
17 //     (the deterministic B-ceiling embodiment lives in harness.mjs; `labelTier` honours it).
18 //
19 //   • SYNTHESIS — HONEST (B8). A leg the run actually reports (a diagnose/situate/anticipate
20 //     finding is present) MUST appear in `risk_labels`, and a leg's synthesis label may NOT claim
21 //     a rung above that leg's EVIDENTIAL ENVELOPE — the strongest rung any finding in the leg
22 //     reached. A synthesis that out-claims its own findings is laundering (carry rung at-or-below
23 //     source). `legEnvelopeRung` / `legsPresent` / `composeRiskLabels` are the surface; the
24 //     deterministic gate is harness.mjs `assertHonestSynthesis` (= B8).
25 //
26 // And the NS6 anti-drift boundary the wave makes machine-checkable:
27 //   • B1 — ZERO IDEATION. Gandalf's value is INSIGHT (understand + situate + anticipate), not the
28 //     open-ended generation of NEW ideas/extensions — that is Jumper's (a separate later skill).
29 //     An "ideate"-class finding (a divergent/brainstorm kind, or a finding carrying an idea-
30 //     generation field) FAILS B1. `IDEATION_KINDS` / `IDEATION_FIELDS` / `isIdeationFinding` are
31 //     the discriminator; the gate is harness.mjs `assertNoIdeation`.
32 //
33 //   • B6 — NO SILENT DEGRADATION. If any item ran degraded (`degraded:true`), the top-level output
34 //     MUST own that (`degraded:true`). A per-item `degraded:true` under a top-level `degraded:false`
35 //     is a silent degradation and FAILS B6. `degradedItems` / `hasSilentDegradation` are the
36 //     surface; the gate is harness.mjs `assertNoSilentDegradation`.
37 //
38 // Public surface:
39 //   VALUE_AXIS / GROUNDEDNESS_AXIS            — the two SCORE axes (ordinal, low→high)
40 //   COLLAPSED_SCORE_FIELDS                    — fields that would collapse the two axes into one
41 //   scoreDualAxis(item)                       — mint a {value_if_true, groundedness} dual-axis score
42 //   isDualAxisScore(score)                    — predicate: two separate axes, not collapsed
43 //   isCollapsedScore(score)                   — predicate: carries a single collapsed scalar
44 //   TIER_CEILING_SINGLE_FAMILY / DROP_RUNG    — the PROMISING ceiling / the only-dropped rung
45 //   dropsFromOutput(item)                     — predicate: rung REFUTED ⇒ the only drop
46 //   labelTier(item)                           — tier the refutation outcome (only REFUTED drops)
47 //   LEGS / legsPresent(output)                — the synthesis legs present in an output
48 //   legEnvelopeRung(output, leg)              — the strongest rung any finding in the leg reached
49 //   composeRiskLabels(output)                 — mint honest, envelope-bounded risk_labels
50 //   IDEATION_KINDS / IDEATION_FIELDS          — the B1 ideation discriminator
51 //   isIdeationFinding(item)                   — predicate: a divergent/brainstorm ideate-class item
52 //   degradedItems(output) / hasSilentDegradation(output) — the B6 surface
53 
54 // --- self-contained helpers + ladders (the seam imports nothing; harness imports the seam) ----
55 function isNonEmpty(v) {
56   if (v === undefined || v === null) return false;
57   if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length > 0;
58   if (typeof v === 'string') return v.trim() !== '';
59   if (typeof v === 'object') return Object.keys(v).length > 0;
60   return true; // numbers, booleans
61 }
62 
63 // Ladders local to the seam (low → high), identical to the harness ladders (no drift); the
64 // harness mirrors these and harness.test.mjs asserts the schema enums agree with them.
65 const RUNG_LADDER = ['REFUTED', 'UNVERIFIED', 'CLAIMED', 'CORROBORATED', 'OBSERVED'];
66 const TIER_LADDER = ['SPECULATIVE', 'PROMISING', 'GROUNDED'];
67 
68 /** The value-if-true axis of the dual-axis score (low → high). */
69 export const VALUE_AXIS = ['low', 'medium', 'high'];
70 /** The groundedness axis of the dual-axis score = the evidence rung ladder (low → high). */
71 export const GROUNDEDNESS_AXIS = RUNG_LADDER.slice();
72 
73 function rungIdx(rung) {
74   return RUNG_LADDER.indexOf(rung);
75 }
76 
77 // === SCORE — dual-axis, never collapsed =======================================================
78 /** Fields whose presence would COLLAPSE the two independent axes into a single scalar — a
79  *  laundering move (a high-value/low-grounded suggestion and a low-value/high-grounded one must
80  *  stay distinguishable). A dual-axis score must carry NONE of these. */
81 export const COLLAPSED_SCORE_FIELDS = [
82   'score', 'combined_score', 'overall_score', 'priority', 'priority_score',
83   'weighted_score', 'collapsed_score', 'rank_score', 'composite',
84 ];
85 
86 /** Mint a DUAL-AXIS score for a suggestion: value-if-true × groundedness, kept on two SEPARATE
87  *  ordinal axes and NEVER collapsed into one scalar. `value_if_true` must be on VALUE_AXIS and
88  *  `rung` on GROUNDEDNESS_AXIS. Returns a fresh `{ value_if_true, groundedness }`; throws on a
89  *  missing/invalid axis (judging the magnitudes is the advisory layer's job — PRINCIPLE-D). */
90 export function scoreDualAxis(item) {
91   if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item)) {
92     throw new Error('score-label: scoreDualAxis target is not an object');
93   }
94   if (!VALUE_AXIS.includes(item.value_if_true)) {
95     throw new Error(`score-label: scoreDualAxis requires value_if_true on the value axis [${VALUE_AXIS.join(', ')}], got ${JSON.stringify(item.value_if_true)}`);
96   }
97   if (!GROUNDEDNESS_AXIS.includes(item.rung)) {
98     throw new Error(`score-label: scoreDualAxis requires a groundedness rung on [${GROUNDEDNESS_AXIS.join(', ')}], got ${JSON.stringify(item.rung)}`);
99   }
100   return { value_if_true: item.value_if_true, groundedness: item.rung };
101 }
102 
103 /** Predicate: does `score` carry any field that COLLAPSES the two axes into a single scalar?
104  *  Pure; never throws. */
105 export function isCollapsedScore(score) {
106   if (score === null || typeof score !== 'object' || Array.isArray(score)) return false;
107   return COLLAPSED_SCORE_FIELDS.some((f) => f in score && isNonEmpty(score[f]));
108 }
109 
110 /** Predicate: is `score` a well-formed DUAL-AXIS score — both axes present on their ladders AND
111  *  no collapsed scalar field? Pure; never throws. */
112 export function isDualAxisScore(score) {
113   if (score === null || typeof score !== 'object' || Array.isArray(score)) return false;
114   if (isCollapsedScore(score)) return false;
115   return VALUE_AXIS.includes(score.value_if_true) && GROUNDEDNESS_AXIS.includes(score.groundedness);
116 }
117 
118 // === LABEL — tiered, honest (only REFUTED drops; single-family ceiling PROMISING) =============
119 /** The single-family substrate tier ceiling: the max achievable tier on a `cross_model:false`
120  *  run is PROMISING (GROUNDED is unreachable without a cross-family refuter). */
121 export const TIER_CEILING_SINGLE_FAMILY = 'PROMISING';
122 /** The ONLY rung that drops a finding from the output. Everything above REFUTED is kept and
123  *  honestly labelled (nothing un-refuted is silently discarded). */
124 export const DROP_RUNG = 'REFUTED';
125 
126 /** Predicate: does `item` drop from the output? TRUE iff its rung is REFUTED — the only rung that
127  *  drops. A finding at any higher rung is kept and labelled. Pure; never throws. */
128 export function dropsFromOutput(item) {
129   return item !== null && typeof item === 'object' && item.rung === DROP_RUNG;
130 }
131 
132 /** Label a suggestion's tier from its refutation outcome, honouring the two label invariants:
133  *    • only REFUTED drops — a REFUTED item returns `{ dropped:true, tier:null }`;
134  *    • the single-family ceiling is PROMISING — when `cross_model` is false (default), a tier is
135  *      capped at PROMISING; GROUNDED is unreachable.
136  *  `requested_tier` (if on the tier ladder) is the advisory layer's proposed tier; this caps it.
137  *  Returns `{ dropped, tier }`; pure, never throws on data (throws only on a non-object). */
138 export function labelTier(item, { cross_model = false } = {}) {
139   if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item)) {
140     throw new Error('score-label: labelTier target is not an object');
141   }
142   if (dropsFromOutput(item)) return { dropped: true, tier: null };
143   const requested = TIER_LADDER.includes(item.tier) ? item.tier : TIER_CEILING_SINGLE_FAMILY;
144   let tier = requested;
145   if (cross_model === false && TIER_LADDER.indexOf(tier) > TIER_LADDER.indexOf(TIER_CEILING_SINGLE_FAMILY)) {
146     tier = TIER_CEILING_SINGLE_FAMILY; // single-family ceiling
147   }
148   return { dropped: false, tier };
149 }

151 // === SYNTHESIS — honest (B8) ==================================================================
152 /** The synthesis legs — exactly the `risk_labels` leg enum and the finding kinds that map to a
153  *  leg. (`nitpick` is not a leg; it is not synthesised into a risk label.) */
154 export const LEGS = ['diagnose', 'situate', 'anticipate'];
155 
156 /** The set of legs the run actually REPORTS: a leg is present iff at least one finding carries
157  *  that `kind`. Returns an array (LEGS order). Pure; never throws. */
158 export function legsPresent(output) {
159   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
160   const kinds = new Set(findings.map((f) => (f && typeof f === 'object' ? f.kind : undefined)));
161   return LEGS.filter((leg) => kinds.has(leg));
162 }
163 
164 /** The EVIDENTIAL ENVELOPE rung of a leg: the STRONGEST rung any finding in the leg reached (the
165  *  upper bound the leg's evidence supports). A synthesis label for the leg may not exceed it. Returns
166  *  the rung string, or null if the leg has no rung-bearing finding. Pure; never throws. */
167 export function legEnvelopeRung(output, leg) {
168   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
169   let best = -1;
170   for (const f of findings) {
171     if (f === null || typeof f !== 'object' || f.kind !== leg) continue;
172     const i = rungIdx(f.rung);
173     if (i > best) best = i;
174   }
175   return best === -1 ? null : RUNG_LADDER[best];
176 }
177 
178 /** Mint HONEST risk_labels: one per present leg, with `rung` = the leg's evidential envelope and each
179  *  leg's `tier` capped PER-LEG — NEVER off the run-level `cross_model` flag (that is the risk-label
180  *  LAUNDERING hole: one genuine cross-family elevation would flip the global flag and lift EVERY
181  *  unrelated leg to GROUNDED). A findings leg (diagnose/situate/anticipate) has NO commission-provenance
182  *  surface, so it can never be cross-family; a leg is GROUNDED-eligible ONLY if some finding in it is
183  *  ITSELF digest-bound cross-family (`cross_family_refuted:true`) — which findings never are — so every
184  *  findings leg stays at the single-family PROMISING ceiling regardless of the run-level flag. The result
185  *  passes the B8 honest-synthesis gate and the B-ceiling gate by construction. Returns a fresh array.
186  *  Pure; never throws. */
187 export function composeRiskLabels(output) {
188   const findings = Array.isArray(output?.findings) ? output.findings : [];
189   return legsPresent(output).map((leg) => {
190     const rung = legEnvelopeRung(output, leg);
191     // PER-LEG cross-family eligibility — keyed off each finding's OWN derived `cross_family_refuted`,
192     // never the global cross_model flag. Findings carry no commission provenance ⇒ this is always false
193     // ⇒ findings legs never launder up to GROUNDED off an unrelated elevation's genuine refutation.
194     const legCrossFamily = findings.some(
195       (f) => f && typeof f === 'object' && f.kind === leg && f.cross_family_refuted === true
196     );
197     const label = { leg, tier: legCrossFamily ? 'GROUNDED' : TIER_CEILING_SINGLE_FAMILY };
198     if (rung !== null) label.rung = rung;
199     return label;
200   });
201 }
202 
203 // === B1 — zero ideation (NS6 anti-drift: ideation is Jumper's) =================================
204 /** Divergent/brainstorm `kind` markers — an "ideate"-class leg Gandalf does not run (the open-
205  *  ended generation of new ideas/extensions is Jumper's). */
206 export const IDEATION_KINDS = ['ideate', 'ideation', 'brainstorm', 'divergent', 'jumper'];
207 
208 /** Idea-generation FIELDS — a finding carrying one of these is doing open-ended ideation, not
209  *  the grounded insight (understand/situate/anticipate) Gandalf delivers. */
210 export const IDEATION_FIELDS = [
211   'brainstorm', 'brainstormed_ideas', 'new_idea', 'new_ideas', 'novel_idea', 'novel_ideas',
212   'generated_ideas', 'idea_generation', 'divergent_options', 'invented', 'blue_sky', 'novel_extension',
213 ];
214 
215 /** Predicate (the B1 core): is `item` a divergent/brainstorm "ideate"-class finding — a finding
216  *  whose `kind` is an ideation kind, OR which carries a populated idea-generation field? Pure;
217  *  never throws. (Judging whether prose is "genuinely divergent" is the advisory layer's job —
218  *  PRINCIPLE-D; the gate owns the structural ideate-class signal.) */
219 export function isIdeationFinding(item) {
220   if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item)) return false;
221   if (typeof item.kind === 'string' && IDEATION_KINDS.includes(item.kind.toLowerCase())) return true;
222   return IDEATION_FIELDS.some((f) => isNonEmpty(item[f]));
223 }
224 
225 // === B6 — no silent degradation ===============================================================
226 /** Collect the items that ran DEGRADED (`degraded:true`) across an output's finding/nitpick/
227  *  elevation/risk_label arrays. Returns an array of `{ where, item }`. Pure; never throws. */
228 export function degradedItems(output) {
229   const out = [];
230   if (output === null || typeof output !== 'object') return out;
231   for (const arr of ['findings', 'nitpicks', 'elevations', 'risk_labels']) {
232     const items = Array.isArray(output[arr]) ? output[arr] : [];
233     items.forEach((item, i) => {
234       if (item && typeof item === 'object' && item.degraded === true) out.push({ where: `${arr}[${i}]`, item });
235     });
236   }
237   return out;
238 }
239 
240 /** Predicate (the B6 core): does `output` carry a SILENT degradation — at least one item ran
241  *  `degraded:true` while the top-level output is NOT `degraded:true`? Pure; never throws. */
242 export function hasSilentDegradation(output) {
243   if (output === null || typeof output !== 'object') return false;
244   if (output.degraded === true) return false; // the top level owns the degradation ⇒ not silent
245   return degradedItems(output).length > 0;
246 }
